name: Hathway Bhawani Cabletel & Datacom Limited
about: Hathway Bhawani Cabletel & Datacom Limited provides cable television network services in India. The company offers digital cable television services. It also operates a movie-based entertainment channel under the Hathway Bhawani Cinema and Movies brand. Hathway Bhawani Cabletel & Datacom Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.
